title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the magnetic susceptibility of the He atom.

title: Paramagnetic or Diamagnetic
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the He atom as diamagnetic based on the sign of the susceptibility.

title: Use of Hamiltonian
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Hamiltonian for the system, including the vector potential and external magnetic field.

title: Differentiation Step
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct differentiation of energy with respect to the magnetic field to find susceptibility.

title: Mean-Square Distance
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the calculation or estimation of the mean-square distance of electrons in the ground state.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the susceptibility calculation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all necessary factors, such as constants like e and c, are included in the final answer.
